content_blocks.title: 23andMe Raw Genotype Data File
content_blocks.content: This is a raw genotype data file generated by 23andMe on Mon Nov 21 23:41:25 2016. The file contains individual SNP genotype calls across the human genome (reference assembly build 37 / Annotation Release 104). Fields are tab-separated: rsid, chromosome, position, genotype. The file includes hundreds of thousands of SNP entries for chromosome 1 and likely other chromosomes (content truncated). Genotypes are oriented with respect to the plus strand on the human reference sequence. The file header notes this data is suitable only for research, educational, and informational use and not for medical or other use.
